description_en: Queries the details of features that are supported by Resource Orchestration Service (ROS)
description_zh: 查询ROS支持的特定功能详情
kebab_example: aliyun ros get-feature-details --feature Terraform --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetFeatureDetails

parameters.help_en:
The one or more features that you want to query. Valid values:

- Terraform: the Terraform hosting feature.

- ResourceCleaner: the resource cleaner feature. You can use ALIYUN::ROS::ResourceCleaner to create a resource cleaner.

- TemplateScratch: the scenario feature.

- All: all features that are supported by ROS
parameters.help_zh:
待查询功能。取值：
- Terraform：Terraform托管功能。

- ResourceCleaner：资源清理器（ALIYUN::ROS::ResourceCleaner）功能。

- TemplateScratch：资源场景功能。

- TemplateParameterConstraints：参数约束查询功能支持的资源属性信息。

- All：所有功能
parameters.name: feature

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the stack. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 资源栈所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id
